app.name: Blinker
app.disclaimer: Blinker is not a medical device. Keep the paper board as a fallback.

counting.emptyCell: Row {{row}} in column {{column}} is empty. Again
counting.spaceNotAdded: No space: the sentence is empty or already ends with a space

page.hint: Nod = yes · Shake your head = no
page.clearMessage: The whole sentence will be removed. Undo letter brings it back.
page.boardCaption: Letter board: columns 1 to {{columns}}, rows 1 to {{rows}}. Tap a letter to add it to the sentence.
page.hintColumn: Nod without a number = space (end of a word) · Shake your head = undo the last letter

voice.noLocalVoice: No Polish voice on this device
voice.noLocalVoiceHelp: No Polish voice on this device, so nothing is read aloud. Install a Polish voice in the system text-to-speech settings.

sentences.empty: No sentences yet. Sentences read aloud on Counting appear here.
sentences.keepHint: Only on this device: at most {{entries}} sentences or {{days}} days. Turning it off deletes them.
sentences.deleteOneMessage: "{{text}}" will be removed from the history.
sentences.clearMessage: Every sentence will be removed from this device. This cannot be undone.
sentences.offMessage: The sentences kept so far will be deleted from this device.

problem.corrupted: The saved sentences could not be read, so the history starts again.
problem.unavailable: This browser does not let Blinker save on the device, so sentences are kept only until the page is closed.

boards.intro: His board is the active board.
boards.previewCaption: Board preview: columns 1 to {{columns}}, rows 1 to {{rows}}.
boards.import: Import a board from a file
boards.importHelp: A JSON file in the board format v1 (docs/board-format.md): at most {{size}} columns and {{size}} rows, up to {{kb}} KB. The file is checked on this device and never sent anywhere.
boards.imported: Imported the board "{{name}}". Choose it above to use it.
boards.replaced: Replaced the board "{{name}}" with the new file.
boards.errorsTitle: Error: the file was not imported ({{count}} problem(s)).
boards.deleteMessage: The board will be removed from this device. His board stays.

problem.corrupted: The saved boards could not be read; only his board is available. Import the files again.
problem.unavailable: This browser does not let Blinker save on the device, so imported boards last only until the page is closed.

errors.too-large: The file is larger than {{limit}} bytes.
errors.not-json: The file is not valid JSON.
errors.not-object: The file must contain one board object.
errors.wrong-type: The value has the wrong type.
errors.invalid-id: The id may contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.invalid-locale: The locale must be a language tag such as pl.
errors.too-long: The value is longer than {{limit}} characters.
errors.row-length: The row must have one cell per column.
errors.unknown-cell-type: The cell type must be char, word or action.
errors.unknown-action: Unknown action; use space, delete, speak, clear or undo.
errors.reserved-id: This id belongs to his built-in board; give the board another id.

settings.privacy: Everything stays on this device: settings, boards and sentences are never sent anywhere.

problem.corrupted: The saved settings could not be read, so the defaults are used. Change a setting to save it again.
problem.unavailable: This browser does not let Blinker save on the device, so settings last only until the page is closed.

counting.signalButtonsHint: Buttons for his signals under the board (there is no camera yet).
counting.keyboardHint: Space = blink, H = hand, N = nod, S = shake, R = finish, P = pause.
counting.hintsHint: A line explaining nod and shake under the question.
